gloss: to incite; to egg on; to sic (a dog) on

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {嗾|けしか}けていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to incite; to egg on; to urge on
definitions.explanation: To provoke or encourage someone to do something, often something aggressive or unwise.

definitions.gloss: to sic; to set (an animal) on
definitions.explanation: To command an animal, especially a dog, to attack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嗾|けしか}けて⟦{反対派|はんたいは}→反対派：30532_hantaiha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦させた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He egged on his subordinates to attack the opposition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嗾|けしか}けられて⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I was egged on by my friends and ended up doing it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嗾|けしか}けて⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧はやめろ。
⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嗾|けしか}けて⟦{追|お}い{払|はら}った→追い払う：06347_oiharau⟧。
examples.english: I sicced the dog on them to chase them away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{番犬|ばんけん}→番犬：22378_banken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嗾|けしか}ける⟦{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}→飼い主：15281_kainushi⟧がいた。
examples.english: There was an owner who would sic their guard dog on people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猟師|りょうし}→猟師：19613_ryoushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{猟犬|りょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲物|えもの}→獲物：08638_emono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嗾|けしか}けた。
examples.english: The hunter sicced the hunting dog on the prey.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嗾|けしか}けられて、⟦{言|い}わなくて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧こと⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧しまった。
examples.english: The children egged me on and I ended up saying things I shouldn't have.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). Pattern: A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嗾|けしか}ける (to sic A on B) or A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嗾|けしか}けて〜⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ (to incite A to do ~)

WRITING:
{嗾|けしか}ける is often written in hiragana as けしかける because the kanji {嗾|けしか} is uncommon.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {嗾|けしか}ける - to incite, egg on (often negative connotation)
- {焚|た}き{付|つ}ける - to stir up, incite
- ⟦{煽|あお}る→煽る：07924_aoru⟧ - to fan, provoke
- ⟦そそのかす→そそのかす：10590_sosonokasu⟧ - to tempt, entice
